_comment: Hand-maintained alias map consumed by scripts/seed-scholarships.mjs. Keys are lowercase, diacritics-stripped aliases as they appear in the source CSV's 'Trường áp dụng' column; values are the canonical university name as stored in public.universities.name. Add entries here whenever a scholarship's school name lands in data/scholarships.unmatched.json. Matching is normalized (lowercased, punctuation-insensitive), so 'UCL' and 'ucl' are equivalent.
hkust: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
kaist: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology
